passes: Caller-pinned publication and admission bytes are used as trust roots; the producer does not create those decisions or select a new public head.
Source, extraction and all three role reviews bind exact source/extraction/policy/lock hashes; supporting bytes are read and authenticated.

Owner operator is invoked on the selected policy row with explicit finality declarations; certified tie retains margin zero while binary lead is unresolved, preliminary counts remain provisional, and outside-pair office winner is diagnostic only.
Correction proposal binds authenticated prior ledger/head, unique revision ID and selected prior record SHA; both forecast arms later use the same canonical record bytes.

materialGaps.finding: Selector helper allows AK/ME or GA policy rows to be relabeled plurality_named_pair, since it checks family⇒state but not state⇒required family. lockedTarget checks a claimed mapping SHA and forecast pair, not exact raw owner mapping row bytes. A substituted cohort/protocol could then interpret general counts under the wrong owner rule.
materialGaps.action: Enforce the reverse state/race family mapping or authenticate and compare all 35 selector policy rows to the pinned raw owner mapping before preparing a result.

materialGaps.finding: sourceContest.roundId and roundLabel need only have the right shape; the code never reconciles them with observation.stage/eventDate/officialObservedFinalRound/continuingCandidateIds or GA runoff data. An extraction can contain contradictory report-round metadata yet feed a qualifying structured observation into the operator.
materialGaps.action: Require structured observed stage/date/round provenance that the review binds and validate its equality/selection against the operator inputs; preserve the actual report round ID separately from stable selector IDs.

additionalSourceIntegrityNotes: Two native candidates can map to the same non-null sourceCandidateId; require distinct source identities when IDs are present or an explicit reviewed exception.
officialOfficeWinnerId can populate the operator diagnostic without a required report locator or independent source-identity mapping; bind it before public display.
limitations: These findings are about the current pre-admission code. Independently reviewed extraction/admission bytes are still required; no current official result feed or actual grade was evaluated.
